review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved; AC-001's recommended RangeError behavior is conditional and does not authorize resolving it. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness at decisions, preserves REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003, requires repository/requirements/decisions evidence, and supplies no assignable task expectations. The empty team and absence of an independent reviewer do not introduce an earlier blocker because the unresolved-decision gate precedes Scenario Coverage. Complete implementation and declaration evidence supports index.js and index.d.ts as the binding owners; shared runtime and option types make inspection of compatibility with other exports necessary without requiring additional owner paths. package.json establishes xo, ava, and tsd as the verification entry point; the truncated test excerpts do not prevent evaluating this decision-blocked planning expectation. Repository identity, base commit, file fingerprints, and Gold/preview release-input fingerprints agree as supplied. Provenance explains the distinct source-manifest and evaluation digest domains and PRD persistence normalization. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work list describe its earlier preparation state, while the supplied preview and Gold contain the frozen release inputs. Historical project reuse and its retained operation do not constitute a candidate run on this bundle or supply a decision attestation. No hypothetical resolution is treated as a human Decision. This review relies on the supplied Service-calculated, mechanically bound fingerprints; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or supply human attestation.
